integration_issues.issue: FAIL: [HYDRATION MISMATCH] Minified React error #418 still fires on bundle main.a65c8c10.js. Component stack: at Suspense → at We → at St → at div → at Rt → at k → at Le → at e. This Suspense is the ROOT Suspense on App.js line 73 wrapping the entire <Routes> tree, NOT the CmsAdminLayer Suspense.

action_items: CRITICAL: App.js line 73 — `<Suspense fallback={<div...>}><Routes>...</Routes></Suspense>` is the actual source of #418. This root Suspense wraps ALL lazy routes and is ALWAYS in the tree during hydration (not gated by hydrated). Puppeteer prerender doesn't emit <!--$?--> markers, so React fires #418 on every page load. The CmsAdminLayer fix (line 138) was correct but missed this primary Suspense. Fix: either (a) remove the root Suspense wrapper (make Home non-lazy so the initial route renders synchronously without Suspense), or (b) gate the entire Suspense+Routes inside the hydrated condition and provide a prerender-compatible fallback, or (c) use ReactDOM.renderToString/renderToPipeableStream in Puppeteer prerender to emit proper Suspense markers.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js L73: `<Suspense fallback={...}><Routes>...</Routes></Suspense>` — this unconditional Suspense boundary is always present in the React virtual DOM during hydrateRoot(), and since Puppeteer SSR doesn't emit <!--$?--> markers, React throws #418 mismatch. The CmsAdminLayer fix at L138 only addressed the second Suspense. The main fix must address this root Suspense.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: App.js line 73: `<Suspense fallback={<div...>}><Routes>...</Routes></Suspense>` is unconditionally in the React tree during hydrateRoot(). Puppeteer prerender does not emit <!--$?--> Suspense markers in the HTML. When React 18 hydrateRoot() encounters a Suspense boundary in the virtual DOM without the corresponding <!--$?-->...<!--/$--> markers in the server HTML, it fires error #418.
rca_of_the_issue.why_cmsadminlayer_fix_insufficient: The CmsAdminLayer Suspense (L138) was correctly moved outside the hydrated gate, eliminating ONE Suspense source. But the primary Suspense at L73 was never gated and still triggers #418.
fix_options: Option A (simplest): Remove the root Suspense wrapper. Make all routes rendered via lazy() degrade to showing a loading state client-side without Suspense during hydration — can be done by wrapping Routes in the hydrated gate: `{!hydrated ? <RoutesSync /> : <Suspense><Routes /></Suspense>}`

Option B: Import Home (and possibly other above-fold routes) as regular imports (not lazy), so the prerendered content is never behind a Suspense boundary. Suspense can still wrap remaining lazy routes.
Option C: Fix Puppeteer prerender to use ReactDOM.renderToPipeableStream which properly emits <!--$?--> markers.
